subcategory: floating pill navbar with glass-morphism effect
use_cases: Primary navigation for SaaS web applications with a modern aesthetic
Responsive bottom navbar for mobile and top-fixed navbar for desktop
Tab-based navigation with active state indicator and smooth transitions
Floating navigation with backdrop blur effect for overlay-style interfaces
Icon and text navigation items with hover effects and visual feedback
ai_summary: A floating glass-morphism navbar component featuring a pill-shaped container with backdrop blur and subtle borders. The navbar adapts responsively between desktop (top-fixed) and mobile (bottom-fixed) layouts, supporting icon and text navigation items with active state management and smooth color transitions. Uses framer-motion for animations and implements a modern SaaS-ready design with hover glow effects on the tube-light styled items.
